hooks.text: Your headphones don't block noise. They make more of it.
The quietest thing you own works by making sound.
Every time you press this button, a tiny chip starts fighting the world.
How do you delete a sound?
Noise cancelling fails on one thing: your friend's voice.
Silence is just two sounds fighting.

hookVariants.visual: A person in headphones on a loud street; noise waves crash in from both sides and stop dead at the ear cups.
Macro on one ear cup: its speaker pumps out a bright wave of its own while a NOISE meter climbs.
Two huge waves, coral and cyan, race toward each other across the frame and collide into a flat line.

beats.text: Your headphones don't block noise. They make *more* of it.
beats.visual: A capsule person wearing big headphones; coral noise waves pour in from a plane and a street; on 'more' the ear cups themselves fire out cyan waves.

beats.text: Tiny microphones on the outside listen to every sound *around* you.
beats.visual: Zoom into the ear cup: a tiny microphone hole glows; the coral noise wave flows into it; callout MICROPHONE.

beats.text: A chip takes that sound wave and flips it upside *down.*
beats.visual: Inside: a glowing chip. The coral wave enters on the left; on 'flips' it mirrors vertically and comes out cyan.

beats.text: Then the speaker plays the flipped wave straight into your *ear.*
beats.visual: The cyan wave travels to a speaker cone that pulses, then on toward an ear shape.

beats.text: Peak meets valley, the two waves *cancel*, and you hear almost nothing.
beats.visual: Coral wave on top, cyan wave below, sliding together; where they overlap the sum goes flat: a calm white line. The person exhales, happy.
The flat line twitches; the mascot robot raises an alarm eye.

beats.text: It works best on steady, low sounds, like the hum of a plane *engine.*
beats.visual: A plane engine with a long, slow, even wave; the cyan copy tracks it perfectly; green check.

beats.text: You see, a steady hum repeats, so the chip can keep *matching* it.
beats.visual: The slow wave loops; the chip's cyan copy locks on, beat after beat.

beats.text: A sudden *voice* changes too fast, and slips right through.
beats.visual: A speech bubble fires a jagged, fast gold wave; the cyan copy lags behind; the gold wave slips past into the ear; the person winces.

beats.text: That's why the padding matters. It blocks the high sounds the chip *can't.*
beats.visual: Cross-section of the ear cup: a thick cushion; small fast gold waves bounce off it; callout PADDING.

beats.text: So the silence you paid for is really two noises *fighting.*
beats.visual: Back to the person on the loud street from frame 0, eyes closed, calm; behind them the coral and cyan waves clash and flatten.
